felt_impact: Small on the CPU fallback only, commonly below 1 ms, potentially a few ms for long brush histories. No GPU slider change; magnitude is unmeasured.
summary: The JPEG CPU preview serializes and parses the local draft immediately before serializing it again in the HTTP body.
evidence: localAdjustments returns plain session JSON plus plain editor data, and no await occurs before the outer JSON.stringify; raw CPU preview already sends the draft directly.
proposed_fix: Keep the outer synchronous request serialization and omit the inner JSON round trip.
check: denoise-preview-presentation.test.js verifies nested draft values, bypass, and comparison cache priority.

felt_impact: Likely below 1 ms per avoided clone with ordinary settings and no change to the backend wait. Relevant only while a non-neutral geometry map is missing or in flight.
summary: The geometry-map path clones the full adjustment tree even when it joins an existing request or is in backoff.
evidence: withCapacityBackoff invokes the fetch callback synchronously or declines without invoking it; request JSON in that callback is a complete snapshot before fetch starts.
proposed_fix: Serialize the adjustment object in the existing fetch callback, once only when sending.
check: geometry-math.test.js verifies the body, same-edit sharing, newer revision independence and capacity recovery.

felt_impact: Near zero with small masks. Long brush histories may save a few ms of main-thread work per overlay frame with mapped geometry, mainly while painting; not measured and no rendering speedup claimed.
summary: Brush overlay frames project every committed point even with a hidden, authoritative or cached mask, and fallback replay repeatedly reacquires the erase context.
evidence: Overlay callers share a keyed raster cache, but point projection preceded visibility and cache checks. The erase canvas retains one 2D context throughout ordered paint/erase replay. The focused test reproduced unnecessary work and checks the resulting alpha and replay order.
proposed_fix: Project stored strokes on fallback raster misses only, and retain the erase context for replay and readback.
check: mask-sampling.test.js checks hidden/authoritative paths, ordered replay, fallback alpha and reuse; real Grade mask overlay check recommended.

summary: A failed Retouch cancel notification leaves an unhandled fetch rejection.
evidence: The click sets the local cancellation flag, then starts a fire-and-forget POST with no rejection handler. The flag still blocks unstarted commands when the backend is unreachable.
proposed_fix: Consume and log the network failure without creating a new user message or changing the local cancel.
check: retouch-source-refresh.test.js clicks Cancel with a rejected fetch and checks the local flag and exact request.

notes: Patch covers edits or drafts present before issuing the load, not the separate window while the server is opening the replacement. Verify with a real sidecar change during a Grade edit before landing.
summary: A clean sidecar check can replace a newer local edit with an external grade.
evidence: A held check is sent with unsaved=false. A slider moves before its reload response arrives. tick loads the external grade anyway, activates a replacement session, and clears documentDirty. The regression reproduced the external session activation before the fix.
proposed_fix: Before automatically loading, verify the same photo and edit token are still clean after draining the already queued edit; let the next poll detect the conflict normally.
check: grade-background-pause.test.js holds the check response, edits locally, verifies the next check reports unsaved, and proves a later clean reload still works.

notes: Only extends the guard to Retouch, which leaves the global adjustment tree unchanged. Other commands can intentionally alter it and need separate merge semantics.
summary: Finishing a Retouch repair can discard a global slider edit made while the repair is in flight.
evidence: set_repairs sends a whole-document acknowledgement but has no global generation guard. A delayed source refresh allowed Exposure to change to 0.7 before the old acknowledgement reset it to 0. The next global save would send the reset value.
proposed_fix: Capture the global edit generation for set_repairs, compare it after source refresh, and preserve newer optimistic adjustments while accepting the repair.
check: edit-sync-retry.test.js delays repair source refresh and checks both the acknowledged repair and the next exact global adjustment payload; exercise on a real long repair.

felt_impact: Likely up to a few ms less main-thread work in a burst with fine or snap held; no expected render-compute change and impact unmeasured.
notes: Visible readout and hover correction are why the code is not landed. Check Ctrl/Shift in the real app, including labels on Temperature.
summary: Hovered modifier sliders rebuild their tick markup per input, and queued work can reapply fine mode after pointer leave.
evidence: Two inputs before a frame queued two callbacks, rebuilt all 41 fine ticks twice, and reformatted the same value from 0.48 to 0.480. The same callback applies cached modifiers without checking the current hover. Snap mode also measures overlap for each rebuilt label.
proposed_fix: Invalidate the ordinary readout on each input, process only the latest input once per frame, and check the hover again before decorating.
check: control-panel-values.test.js checks final fine readout, one tick build, and ordinary styling after leaving before the frame.

felt_impact: Small main-thread improvement, likely below 1 ms per ordinary input. No change to CPU/GPU render wait; not measured.
summary: The save status chrome replaces unchanged text nodes on every global edit and twice per successful idle poll.
evidence: markGlobalEditDirty calls syncProjectBadge per input, which calls render. That function assigned the same photo title, autosave label and save state even after the first dirty transition. The backend returns a full session only when its current same-photo session ID was replaced, not for unchanged polls.
proposed_fix: Set text only when it changed. Keep processing each edit token, the save delay and all original UI states.
check: grade-background-pause.test.js verifies title, dirty status and repeated edit notifications without unchanged text writes; grade-open-loading also passes.
